blocks.text: James Reid surprised a couple by attending their wedding reception, where the actor-singer treated them and the guests to a live performance of his new song “Attention.” Reid traveled to Amadeo, Cavite to meet newlyweds Dariz Kho and Emman Pelayo and present them his gift on Monday, Sept. 21. It was not immediately known how the singer knew the pair. “It’s not something I usually get to do, but the timing just lined up this time,” James said. “Hearing Dariz and Emman’s story, I was glad I could be a small part of their day.
